args.sql:
WITH PriceChanges AS (
    SELECT 
        mktnote AS market_pair,
        (ms.priceshiftday * 100 / ms.openstake) AS avg_price_change_24h,
        ((ms.highspotday - ms.lowspotday) * 100 / ms.lowspotday) AS avg_price_change_4h,
        ((md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'askquote')::numeric - (md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'bidquote')::numeric) * 100 / (md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'bidquote')::numeric AS avg_price_change_1h
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        marketdata md ON o.mktnote = md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'mktcombo'
    JOIN 
        marketstats ms ON o.mktnote = ms.mdlink
),
SmartTradingSuccessRate AS (
    SELECT 
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'flowimbal' AS flow_category,
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'whalemotion' AS whale_driven_market_activity,
        pc.market_pair,
        pc.avg_price_change_1h,
        pc.avg_price_change_4h,
        pc.avg_price_change_24h,
        (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'smartforce')::numeric / (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'retailflow')::numeric AS smart_trading_success_rate
    FROM 
        analyticsindicators ai
    JOIN 
        marketdata md ON ai.mdataref = md.marketdatanode
    JOIN 
        PriceChanges pc ON md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'mktcombo' = pc.market_pair
)
SELECT 
    flow_category,
    whale_driven_market_activity,
    market_pair,
    AVG(avg_price_change_1h) AS avg_price_change_1h,
    AVG(avg_price_change_4h) AS avg_price_change_4h,
    AVG(avg_price_change_24h) AS avg_price_change_24h,
    AVG(smart_trading_success_rate) AS avg_smart_trading_success_rate
FROM 
    SmartTradingSuccessRate
GROUP BY 
    flow_category, whale_driven_market_activity, market_pair
ORDER BY 
    avg_smart_trading_success_rate DESC;

args.sql:
WITH PriceChanges AS (
    SELECT 
        o.mktnote AS market_pair,
        (ms.priceshiftday * 100 / ms.openstake) AS avg_price_change_24h,
        ((ms.highspotday - ms.lowspotday) * 100 / ms.lowspotday) AS avg_price_change_4h,
        ((md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'askquote')::numeric - (md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'bidquote')::numeric) * 100 / (md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'bidquote')::numeric AS avg_price_change_1h
    FROM 
        orders o
    JOIN 
        marketdata md ON o.mktnote = md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'mktcombo'
    JOIN 
        marketstats ms ON md.mdlink = ms.mdlink -- Corrected join condition
),
SmartTradingSuccessRate AS (
    SELECT 
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'flowimbal' AS flow_category,
        ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'whalemotion' AS whale_driven_market_activity,
        pc.market_pair,
        pc.avg_price_change_1h,
        pc.avg_price_change_4h,
        pc.avg_price_change_24h,
        (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'smartforce')::numeric / (ai.market_sentiment_indicators->>'retailflow')::numeric AS smart_trading_success_rate
    FROM 
        analyticsindicators ai
    JOIN 
        marketdata md ON ai.mdataref = md.marketdatanode
    JOIN 
        PriceChanges pc ON md.quote_depth_snapshot->>'mktcombo' = pc.market_pair
)
SELECT 
    flow_category,
    whale_driven_market_activity,
    market_pair,
    AVG(avg_price_change_1h) AS avg_price_change_1h,
    AVG(avg_price_change_4h) AS avg_price_change_4h,
    AVG(avg_price_change_24h) AS avg_price_change_24h,
    AVG(smart_trading_success_rate) AS avg_smart_trading_success_rate
FROM 
    SmartTradingSuccessRate
GROUP BY 
    flow_category, whale_driven_market_activity, market_pair
ORDER BY 
    avg_smart_trading_success_rate DESC;
